Data providers, service credits, and Android playback licenses used by HoneyFlix TV.

HoneyFlix uses the TMDB API for movie and TV metadata, artwork, trailers, cast, production details, collections, and recommendations. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
HoneyFlix connects to Trakt for account authentication, watched history, progress sync, library data, ratings, lists, and comments. HoneyFlix is not affiliated with or endorsed by Trakt.

HoneyFlix connects to Simkl for account authentication, watchlists, watched history, playback progress, and scrobbling. Movie, TV, and anime tracking data is provided by Simkl. HoneyFlix is not affiliated with or endorsed by Simkl.
HoneyFlix connects to Premiumize for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. HoneyFlix is not affiliated with or endorsed by Premiumize.
HoneyFlix connects to TorBox for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. HoneyFlix is not affiliated with or endorsed by TorBox.
HoneyFlix uses MDBList for ratings, watched history and playback tracking. HoneyFlix is not affiliated with or endorsed by MDBList.
HoneyFlix uses the IntroDB API for community-provided intro, recap, credits, and preview timestamps used by skip controls. HoneyFlix is not affiliated with or endorsed by IntroDB.

HoneyFlix uses IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets, including title.ratings.tsv.gz, for IMDb ratings and vote counts. Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission. IMDb data is for personal and non-commercial use under IMDb terms.
